states.source: settings_account renders phone/email/profile/history/host rows from current profile data.
states.nextAction: Keep this as the profile-backed baseline while mutation lifecycle captures finish.

states.source: SettingsAccountState maps profile provider loading to explicit account row values instead of blank fallbacks.
states.nextAction: Compare against the Settings Account reference once provider-free visual sections are polished.

states.source: SettingsAccountState maps profile provider errors to explicit unavailable row values and an inline retry surface.
states.nextAction: Keep profile-provider retry copy on the shared branded error surface.

states.source: SettingsAccountState maps a signed-in but missing profile to unavailable row values and account-unavailable copy.
states.nextAction: Decide whether missing profile should route to profile recovery or sign-out recovery.

states.source: Review history, Payment history, and Host app rows are stable semantic account actions.
states.nextAction: Add route-navigation tests for review/payment rows and keep host app external-link proof.

states.source: Catch Host and configured privacy, support, and terms rows use one route-owned external-link operation. The selected row shows progress, the whole Settings surface freezes while pending, false and thrown failures show honest feedback, and actions restore afterward.
states.nextAction: Keep the destination policy separate from launch integrity; whether Catch Host stays external or becomes an in-app role switch remains an owner decision.

states.source: Preference toggles optimistically update local CatchToggleInput state and persist through SettingsController.savePreference; any settings mutation freezes every settings action plus route exit, while SettingsController deduplicates overlapping preference, unblock, and delete calls.
states.nextAction: Keep whole-surface exclusivity intact while comparing the disabled-toggle pending affordance during visual polish.

states.source: Failed preference writes roll back optimistic switch state and surface mutation error copy.
states.nextAction: Compare preference error copy and placement against the Settings mutation contract during visual polish.

states.source: settings_account captures privacy/safety rows including blocked users, visibility copy, map visibility toggle, privacy policy, and delete account.
states.nextAction: Use the exported Settings Account reference to compare privacy/safety row hierarchy; add delete dialog and mutation lifecycle route captures.

states.source: Blocked accounts footer renders _BlockedAccountsSkeleton while loading and CatchLocalizedErrorState (inline/compact mode) with retry on failure.
states.nextAction: Keep blocked-account provider retry copy on the shared branded error surface.

states.source: No blocked accounts renders the No blocked accounts CatchEmptyState.
states.nextAction: Use the exported Settings Account reference as the first settings baseline; keep empty footer covered when extracting settings sections.

states.source: Blocked accounts resolve public profiles in one batch and render PersonRow tiles with unblock buttons.
states.nextAction: Keep blocked-account row composition stable while comparing pending/error mutation affordances.

states.source: Unblock action routes through SettingsController.unblockUserMutation and shows shared Catch snackbar success feedback; pending unblock freezes every settings action and route exit, and the controller rejects overlapping settings writes.
states.nextAction: Compare unblock pending/error affordances during visual polish without weakening whole-surface exclusivity.

states.source: Delete account row opens the confirm danger dialog and delegates confirmed deletion to SettingsController.requestAccountDeletion; the dialog rechecks global pending state, and delete pending freezes every settings action plus route exit.
states.nextAction: Add a dedicated confirm-dialog capture if destructive-dialog pixel parity becomes blocking.

states.source: Log out row delegates to AuthSessionController.signOutMutation and shows a pending spinner; sign-out pending freezes every settings action and route exit, while AuthSessionController returns the active session future to duplicate callers.
states.nextAction: Compare sign-out pending/error affordances during visual polish without weakening whole-surface exclusivity.

states.source: Settings Account uses the shared obviousOfflineException/appErrorDescriptor copy for provider retry surfaces and mutation feedback instead of a Settings-specific offline copy.
states.nextAction: Reopen only if product requires Settings-specific offline copy that diverges from the shared app error catalogue.

states.source: settings_text_scale_2 captures account rows, toggles, blocked user rows, destructive rows, and footers at text scale 2.0.
states.nextAction: Repeat text-scale review after final Settings visual parity polish.

states.source: settings_reduced_motion captures the Settings Account route with animations disabled.
states.nextAction: Add reduced-motion proof for destructive confirmation and mutation feedback.

states.source: The capture runner emits paired light/dark outputs for Settings Account blocked-list, text-scale, and reduced-motion fixtures.
states.nextAction: Compare both themes after final Settings visual parity polish.

composition.currentLayout: SettingsScreen combines profile seeding, optimistic local preference state, SettingsController mutations, sign-out, external links, blocked-user provider waves, batched profile lookup, confirmation dialogs, and all row/section composition in one route widget.
composition.targetLayout: Settings Account should resolve a SettingsAccountState adapter for profile rows, preference draft/pending/error state, blocked-account rows, destructive/account actions, route callbacks, external links, retry intents, and mutation feedback before composing provider-free settings sections.
